query: proof required when a work computer must be exchanged

results.title: Device Support Policy
results.content: Replacement laptop requests need an asset tag, fault description, and a diagnostics screenshot or diagnostic reference. High or Critical drafts require human review.

results.title: Request Priority Guide
results.content: High priority applies when a core job function is blocked and no reasonable workaround exists. The current P2 acknowledgement target is three business hours.
